dialog.saveChanges.note: Office: Excel's message box "Do you want to save the changes you made to <name>?" with Save / Don't Save / Cancel (gridcraft show.rs:293); the text comes from core/common/commands/file.mjs saveChangesText.

dialog.open.note: The system Open dialog (gridcraft files.rs services.pick_open): file.open asks main for it (electron/main.cjs studio:file-pick-open); no in-app dialog.

dialog.saveAs.note: The system Save As dialog (gridcraft backstage.rs:700, native picker): file.saveAs asks main for it (electron/main.cjs studio:file-pick-save); no in-app dialog.

dialog.start.note: Excel's Start screen is File > Home (src/shell/backstage/pages.tsx HomePage: Blank workbook + Recent); the template gallery is not translated yet.

dialog.openPassword.note: Opening password-protected workbooks is not translated yet (the format worker cannot decrypt them); the dialog stays hidden until it is.
